attBesluta.text: Instructions don't tell you that there are two different sizes of screws. There are a few larger ones included - which are needed for the top support bar. Other than that, it's awesome. Easy to assemble and sturdy.
Due to our expanded outreach and partner development, we have now purchased four of these brochure holders. We have doubled the size of our advertising kiosk.
Very solidly built. Easy to assemble, set-up was easy. Would buy again.

We lease our space and we are limited on wall space to mount "permanent" displays for flyers and information. This is our second purchase of the VEVOR Brochure Display Rack" It is mobile, durable and spacious. With this second rack, we have been able to double the flyer in our advertising and outreach kiosk.
It displays my pamphlets very nicely and makes my office look more professional.
Easy to assembly but not very sturdy or durable. Good for the price but if able to, would recommend going up another tier in quality
Perfect for our intended purpose to mark driveways for snow in winter.
Super great price, will update the quality after this winter season

Got these to line the road to our cabin. They work well, and should be great in the snow. Only issue is that the pointed tips sometimes fall off when trying to remove them from soil. Not a big deal as the tips are not really needed. Happy with the purchase, and have only used 10 of the 100 I received so far.
Todo perfecto llego a tiempo, buena calidad, a buen precio
